name: Artist's Palette
text: If you own sigils of three or more colors, gain +20 contract value.
archetypes: Bonus Chaser, Diamond Flood, Heart Chorus; any splashing collection
decision: Shopping: chase a fifth resonance with a splash, weighing off-plan offers higher until it is on.
aiNote: Until five resonances are owned, add 15 points of value to an offer of a new resonance.
rationale: A typical collection holds two colors and Gray by mid-run, so three colors is the common case and this is a steady +20 (about +16 expected) at uncommon, lower than before because it is on in most rounds; a signpost counts both its colors.
deviation: Revision 1: threshold lowered from five colors to three, and the reward from +30 to +20.
